_about: The owner's list of Cook at Home recipes that move into his own data as personal `u:` recipes (roadmap 510/050, owner-ruled 2026-10-01). Read by tools/move_recipes.mjs, which rewrites an exported backup so these recipes, and every heart, rating, note and shopping line on them, live under the `u:` ids. Ids only: the recipe text comes from site/data/restaurants/<venueId>.json, or data/history/dishes/<venueId>.json once the published copy has left.
